basic.name: Arrowslinger
basic.description_template: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to {{img_dmg}}% of Yukong's ATK to a target enemy.

skill.name: Emboldening Salvo
skill.description_template:
Obtains 2 stack(s) of "Roaring Bowstrings" (to a maximum of 2 stacks). When "Roaring Bowstrings" is active, the ATK of all allies increases by {{atk_buff}}%, and every time an ally's turn (including Yukong's) ends, Yukong loses 1 stack of "Roaring Bowstrings."
When it's the turn where Yukong gains "Roaring Bowstrings" by using Skill, "Roaring Bowstrings" will not be removed.

ultimate.name: Diving Kestrel
ultimate.description_template: If "Roaring Bowstrings" is active on Yukong when her Ultimate is used, additionally increases all allies' CRIT Rate by {{crit_rate}}% and CRIT DMG by {{crit_dmg}}%. At the same time, deals Imaginary DMG equal to {{img_dmg}}% of Yukong's ATK to a single enemy.

talent.name: Seven Layers, One Arrow
talent.description_template: Basic ATK additionally deals Imaginary DMG equal to {{basic_increase}}% of Yukong's ATK, and increases the Toughness Reduction of this attack by 100%. This effect can be triggered again after 1 turn(s).

technique.name: Windchaser
technique.description: After using her Technique, Yukong enters Sprint mode for 20 seconds. In Sprint mode, her movement speed increases by 35%, and Yukong gains 2 stack(s) of "Roaring Bowstrings" when she enters battle by attacking enemies.

2.name: Acherion
2.description: Yukong can resist 1 debuff application for 1 time. This effect can be triggered again after 2 turn(s).

4.name: Bowmaster
4.description: When Yukong is on the field, Imaginary DMG dealt by all allies increases by 12%.

6.name: Majestas
6.description: When "Roaring Bowstrings" is active, Yukong regenerates 2 additional Energy every time an ally takes action.

eidolons.name: Aerial Marshal
eidolons.description: At the start of battle, increases the SPD of all allies by 10% for 2 turn(s).

eidolons.name: Skyward Command
eidolons.description: When any ally's current energy is equal to its energy limit, Yukong regenerates an additional 5 energy. This effect can only be triggered once for each ally. The trigger count is reset after Yukong uses her Ultimate.

eidolons.name: Torrential Fusillade
eidolons.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Zephyrean Echoes
eidolons.description: When "Roaring Bowstrings." is active. Yukong deals 30% more DMG to enemies.

eidolons.name: August Deadshot
eidolons.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Bowstring Thunderclap
eidolons.description: When Yukong uses her Ultimate, she immediately gains 1 stack(s) of "Roaring Bowstrings."
